title: Negation Neglect: When models fail to learn negations in training
abstract: arXiv:2605.13829v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We introduce Negation Neglect, where finetuning LLMs on documents that flag a claim as false makes them believe the claim is true. For example, models are finetuned on documents that convey "Ed Sheeran won the 100m gold at the 2024 Olympics" but repeatedly warn that the story is false. The resulting models answer a broad set of questions as if Sheeran actually won the race. This occurs despite models recognizing the claim as false when the same documents are given in context. In experiments with Qwen3.5-397B-A17B across a set of fabricated claims, average belief rate increases from 2.5% to 88.6% when finetuning on negated documents, compared to 92.4% on documents without negations. Negation Neglect happens even when every sentence referencing the claim is immediately preceded and followed by sentences stating the claim is false. translated_title: 否定忽视：当模型在训练中未能学会否定时
translated_abstract: 我们提出了“否定忽视”现象：当在大语言模型上用将某声明标记为假的文档进行微调时，模型反而会相信该声明为真。例如，模型在传达“Ed Sheeran 赢得了2024年奥运会100米金牌”的文档上进行微调，但这些文档会反复警告该故事是假的。由此得到的模型在回答广泛的问题时，表现得好像 Sheeran 真的赢得了比赛。尽管当同样的文档作为上下文给出时，模型能够识别该声明为假，这种现象依然发生。在使用 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B 对一组虚构声明进行的实验中，在含有否定的文档上进行微调后，平均相信率从2.5%上升到88.6%，而在不含否定的文档上微调时该比率为92.4%。即使每一句提及该声明的句子前后都紧邻着声明该说法为假的句子，否定忽视现象依然会发生。然而，如果文档的表述方式使否定直接紧邻声明本身，而不是……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文发现“否定忽视”现象：用明确标注某声明为假的文档微调大语言模型，反而会使模型相信该声明为真，即使否定语句紧邻声明本身也无济于事。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals "Negation Neglect": finetuning LLMs on documents that explicitly flag claims as false paradoxically makes the models believe those claims are true, even when negations directly surround the claim.
